## Company Overview
ZEALL FRP Grating is a leading China-based FRP (Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic) grating manufacturer with 20+ years of experience. We offer the same premium quality as famous brands like Fibergrate and Strongwell at 40-60% lower factory-direct pricing.

## Key Advantages (Why Choose ZEALL Over Other Brands)
1. Same Quality Standard - ISO 9001, ASTM E-84 certified. Same raw material quality as Fibergrate & Strongwell.
2. 40-60% Lower Price - Factory-direct pricing saves significant costs compared to famous brands.
3. 1 PC MOQ - No minimum order quantity, both small and large orders welcome.
4. 20+ Year Warranty - Longer than industry standard 10-15 years.
5. 20+ Years Manufacturing Experience - 200+ employees, full in-house production.
6. Custom Fabrication & Engineering - CAD drawings, structural calculations, engineering team support.
7. One-Stop Solution & Fast Lead Time - 15-25 day delivery, faster than 30-45 days of famous brands.
8. Trusted by 541+ Global Customers - 4.9/5 rating, 65%+ repurchase rate, exported to 40+ countries.

## Product Line (8 Categories)
1. FRP Molded Grating - 25/30/38/50mm thickness, 19x19/38x38 mesh, Concave/Smooth/Grit-top/Covered surfaces
2. FRP Pultruded Grating - High load capacity, unidirectional strength, for large spans
3. FRP Covers & Panels - Solid covers, trench covers, cable trench covers, equipment panels
4. FRP Pultruded Profiles - I-beam, channel, angle, square tube, round tube, flat bar
5. FRP Handrail & Stair System - Complete modular system, corrosion resistant, no welding
6. Fiberglass Fabric - E-Glass, 200-800 g/m², plain/twill/satin weave
7. Grating Clips - M/C/L/Z type, SS304/SS316/HDG steel
8. Fiberglass Mesh & Tape - Alkali-resistant mesh, self-adhesive tape

## Applications (8 Major Industries)
1. Water & Wastewater Treatment - sewage plants, aeration tanks, sedimentation tanks
2. Chemical & Petrochemical & Electroplating - acid-alkali environments, pickling workshops
3. Power & New Energy - substations, solar PV walkways, wind power
4. Marine & Coastal - docks, piers, offshore platforms, seawater desalination
5. Rail Transit & Tunnel Engineering - metro, highway tunnels, cable trenches
6. Municipal Infrastructure - drainage covers, tree grates, pedestrian bridges
7. Food-Pharma & Livestock - clean workshops, livestock flooring
8. General Industry - workshops, car washes, equipment platforms
